sights.n: Lake Akan Ainu Kotan (阿寒湖アイヌコタン)
sights.address: Akanko Onsen, Akan-chō, Kushiro, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: Hokkaido's largest Ainu settlement (about 120 residents) on Lake Akan — craft shops, the Ikor theatre's UNESCO-listed traditional dances and Ainu restaurants.
100 m cliffs at the tip of the Etomo Peninsula with a white octagonal lighthouse and a sweep of the Pacific.

sights.address: South side of Mount Hakodate, Hakodate, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: A 30 m cliff on the south side of Mount Hakodate jutting into the Tsugaru Strait — on clear days the Shimokita and Tsugaru peninsulas of Aomori across the water.

sights.address: 53-2 Konopporo, Atsubetsu-chō, Atsubetsu-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: The prefecture's museum of nature and history beside the Historical Village — five themes including Ainu culture, history and wildlife.
Japan's first bird sanctuary (1981) on the edge of Tomakomai — whooper swans and white-fronted geese stop over from autumn to spring.
